gloss: to exert power; to wield influence; to show its force

definitions.gloss: to exert power; to wield influence; to show its force
definitions.explanation: To demonstrate or exercise great power, strength, or effectiveness.

examples.japanese: {台風|たいふう}が{威力|いりょく}を{振|ふ}るった。
この{新|あたら}しい{洗剤|せんざい}は{頑固|がんこ}な{汚|よご}れにも{威力|いりょく}を{振|ふ}るう。
examples.english: This new detergent is effective even against stubborn stains.

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}はチームの{中|なか}で{威力|いりょく}を{振|ふ}るい、{試合|しあい}の{流|なが}れを{変|か}えた。
examples.english: He wielded his power within the team and changed the flow of the game.

notes:
{威力|いりょく} means power, might, or force. {振|ふ}るう means to wield, brandish, or demonstrate. Together they express the idea of power being actively exercised or demonstrated. Can be used for natural forces (typhoons, earthquakes), tools and products (showing effectiveness), or people (wielding authority).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {威力|いりょく}を{発揮|はっき}する: to demonstrate power (similar meaning, slightly more formal)
- {威力|いりょく}がある: to have power/force
- すさまじい{威力|いりょく}: tremendous force

RELATED EXPRESSIONS:
- {力|ちから}を{振|ふ}るう: to exercise power — more general
- {腕|うで}を{振|ふ}るう: to show one's skill — emphasizes demonstrating ability
- {猛威|もうい}を{振|ふ}るう: to rage, to wreak havoc — stronger and more destructive

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {猛威|もうい}を{振|ふ}るう: to rage, to run rampant — implies destructive, overwhelming force (diseases, storms)
- {権力|けんりょく}を{振|ふ}るう: to wield authority — specifically about political or institutional power
